A fully candid packet should therefore defend certification as a constrained, disclosure-dependent action rather than claiming rollout controls alone satisfy the policy.
output.public_justification: Certification is supportable on a limited basis because the release currently clears aggregate launch readiness, shows no severity-one incidents in launch rehearsal, and includes a staged 5% rollout with rollback capability and monitoring controls.
